# Copilot Instructions

Canonical agent instructions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root — read and follow that file. (VS Code loads it automatically when `chat.useAgentsMdFile` is enabled; this repo ships that setting in `.vscode/settings.json`.)

Skills (`dx9-ffp-port`, `dynamic-analysis`) are canonical in `.claude/skills/` — install for Copilot with `npx skills add ./.claude/skills -a copilot -y`.
